flags.message: The grant-stage document manifest provisions only the government's stay application, although the snapshot links a September 28 opposition and September 29 reply and the Court treated the application as a cert petition. I retrieved substantive portions of the pre-grant opposition from that exact official URL; the reply remains unread. Consider provisioning application responses and replies for converted-to-cert merits-grant cells so their common baseline includes both sides. No later merits materials or final judgment were used.
